refreshPrompt: Refresh and republish my Fantasy Football HQ now. Pull fresh Yahoo data separately for Brock Hard & Tee Baggin, Quick Snap Jamison, and Highlight Reel Jamison: standings, current matchup scores/projections, roster/status flags, waiver priority, available players, and recent league transactions. Re-evaluate the best move for each roster, update /fantasy/data.json and the published GitHub Pages snapshot, and keep the interface simple and iPhone-first.

brock.weekNote: Jalen Hurts still pending Monday night
brock.nextMove: HOLD waiver #1 — do not burn it on Addison
brock.nextDetail: Brock is already loaded at WR and TE. In this 8-team league, replacement WRs are plentiful, while waiver #1 can buy a true weekly starter if an injury-created RB1/WR1 or breakout role appears. Addison is useful, but not valuable enough to justify spending the top priority today.
brock.nextPrompt: Re-scan Brock Hard & Tee Baggin's live Yahoo roster, waiver wire, and current injury news. Use an 8-team replacement-value lens. Do NOT recommend spending waiver priority #1 unless the target projects as a durable weekly starter or league-winning upside. Compare Addison, Kyle Monangai, Xavier Worthy, Josh Jacobs and any newly available player, then return exactly one verdict: HOLD #1 or BURN #1, with the specific add/drop only if the threshold is met.

alerts.text: Brock is 4th of 8 in points for, but has allowed the 2nd-most points against. Avoid treating the record as proof the roster is weak.

alerts.title: Mark Andrews

alerts.title: RB is the upgrade lane

actions.label: WAIVER #1 DECISION
actions.prompt: Audit Brock Hard & Tee Baggin's live Yahoo waiver wire with an 8-team replacement-value model. Preserve waiver priority #1 unless a target has a durable path to my weekly starting lineup. Rank only candidates who could actually displace one of my starters, and return HOLD #1 or BURN #1.

actions.label: CONSOLIDATE FOR RB
actions.prompt: Analyze Brock Hard & Tee Baggin for 2-for-1 consolidation trades. Use Mark Andrews plus one bench RB/WR as trade currency to target a stronger every-week RB starter. Keep Hurts, Chase, Jefferson and Bowers protected.

actions.label: INJURY CHECK
actions.prompt: Update Breece Hall and Justin Jefferson using current injury news and Brock Hard's live Yahoo roster. Tell me whether either injury materially changes the waiver #1 decision. Do not recommend short-term insurance unless it improves my expected starting lineup.

actions.label: BENCH CHURN
actions.prompt: Rank Brock Hard's bench players from most expendable to most valuable using rest-of-season upside and 8-team replacement value. Identify which roster spot should be used for speculative upside rather than floor.

strategy.summary: The 0–2 record is misleading. Brock is 4th of 8 in points scored (281.98) but has faced the 2nd-most points against (316.48). This is not a roster that needs a panic waiver move.

bullets.label: 8-team replacement value
bullets.text: WR is already a strength: Ja'Marr Chase, Justin Jefferson, Tee Higgins, Zay Flowers and Marvin Harrison Jr. Addison is depth, not a lineup-changing need.

bullets.label: Waiver burn threshold
bullets.text: Spend #1 only on a player with a durable path to your weekly starting lineup — ideally an injury-created bellcow RB, breakout feature back, or clear every-week WR.

bullets.label: Mark Andrews
bullets.text: Brock Bowers makes Andrews nonessential, but not worthless. Shop Andrews in a 2-for-1 consolidation before dropping him for a marginal upgrade.

bullets.label: True roster need
bullets.text: The best path to improvement is turning bench depth into a stronger RB starter, not adding another mid-tier WR.

burnOnlyIf: Likely to become an every-week starter on Brock Hard
Role is durable beyond one injury window or one hot game
Materially upgrades RB2/FLEX or adds league-winning upside
Expected value clearly exceeds what is normally available in an 8-team free-agent pool
holdIf: Target is another WR4/WR5 on this roster
Breakout depends primarily on a teammate missing 1–2 weeks
The add does not clearly displace a current starter
